channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Practice Makes Perfect
item.description: Makes songs need practice before they sound right, and makes cheap instruments sound cheap

item.title: fStats
item.description: A stat library for use with fClasses and fSkills.

item.title: Prosequor - Skills, Levels, Trees and Stats
item.description: Adds a full-throated, first-class skill, levelling and attributes system to Vintage Story.

item.title: Burdens of Mortality
item.description: A detailed health journal with localized injuries, bleeding, treatment and lasting impairments.

item.title: Envelopes
item.description: Adds wax-sealable envelopes to the game. Privacy-first.

item.title: Raft Dismount Fix
item.description: Fixes getting off rafts and boats dropping you in the water when the server lags

item.title: GildedChronicles - Translocator Repair
item.description: Adds the ability to repair an unrepairable translocator.

item.title: Directional Wind
item.description: Makes the wind change direction over time, with foliage and rain following it

item.title: Ardyn Leveling
item.description: Deep profession-based progression with customizable talent trees and hundreds of unique skills.

item.title: 𝓦𝓻𝓲𝓽𝓽𝓮𝓷 𝓦𝓸𝓻𝓭 - parchment and book overhaul
item.description: Parchment and book overhaul. Parchments can be placed on walls, adds nickname-only signatures

item.title: GildedChronicles - Tapestry Repair
item.description: Craft a temporal loom to create temporal sewing kits, to restore rotten tapestries.

item.title: CreatureContainerBagFix
item.description: Fixes empty animal traps staying in bag slots as an extra 8-slot bag after releasing the animal

item.title: Geekotrain
item.description: additional train for YTT

item.title: Nf3t - Translocator Locator (Cheat)
item.description: Adds a command to find Translocators as waypoints.

item.title: Nf3t - Copy Better Ruins Schematics
item.description: Allows players to duplicate Better Ruins blueprints / schematics using parchment or paper.

item.title: Nf3t - Center Map
item.description: Adds a command to center the map at a specific coordinate.

item.title: Nf3t - Translocator Navigator
item.description: Calculates the shortest path between your current position and a target, factoring in translocators.

item.title: fSkills
item.description: A skill and XP mod to support fClasses for Fragments RP.

item.title: Sound Physics Adapted
item.description: Realistic Raytraced Audio. Walls depending on thickness and material muffle sounds and much more!

item.title: Dead
item.description: Leaves a lootable corpse of the player (with their exact skin and worn gear) at the death spot

item.title: Rough Seas
item.description: The sea gets weather: storms, surf, currents. And six new vessels that wear, swamp and break.

item.title: Craft Cache
item.description: Craft Cache is a performance fix mod for the "The Revived Lands" server (Vintage Story 1.22.x).

item.title: Signals Link YTT
item.description: Bridge mod: Signals Link docks load and unload Yang's Transport Tycoon trains automatically.

item.title: Disabled Dungeon Spawns (TP only)
item.description: Disables procedural dungeons entirely when using Terra Prety

item.title: Vintage Story Mod Manager - VMM
item.description: A lightweight, minimalist desktop mod manager, modpack sharer, and multiplayer launcher.

item.title: [Silver`s] Dice and Cards
item.description: A simple mod that adds board games and cards for playing with friends. Poker, Dice, Chess, etc.

item.title: VS save editor
item.description: Save editor for vintage story, map export chunk managment and block/entity search.

item.title: LTO Breeding Plus
item.description: Animal husbandry: breeding bale zones, hearts, milk, manure and a rideable elk.

item.title: LTO Stamina Plus
item.description: An immersive survival mod introducing fatigue, energy, and thirst management.

item.title: LTO Immersive Plus
item.description: An immersive mod adding visual block damage and realistic tree-falling mechanics.
